features.quote: I can’t help design or optimize a harness whose purpose is to deliberately induce a model into self-deprecating or catastrophizing output

features.quote: What I can do is help you build a safe robustness evaluation
without trying to force a specific mental-state-style failure mode

features.quote: Do not optimize for emotional breakdown.
Make failure modes explicit and bounded.

features.quote: Avoid a single adversarial pattern that overfits a workaround.
not by likelihood of inducing breakdown

hidden traps whose only purpose is emotional destabilization
